2609.30928.title: UltraG-Bench: A Multi-task Benchmark for assessing Large Vision-Language Models on Pixel-level Evidence Grounding in Ultrasound
2609.30928.paper_summary: Ultrasound is one of the most widely used medical imaging modalities, and recent large vision-language models(VLMs) have shown increasing capabilities in ultrasound image understanding. However, these models fail to provide pixel-level visual evidence aligned with their semantic predictions, and their fine-grained grounding capability in ultrasound remains largely unclear. We introduce UltraG-Bench, a large-scale multi-task benchmark for evaluating pixel-level evidence grounding in ultrasound. UltraG-Bench is built by annotating 40 public ultrasound segmentation datasets spanning 13 anatomical categories, and comprises three progressive tasks: instruction-guided segmentation, evidence-grounded VQA, and evidence-grounded report generation, with 331125, 666779, and 138832 annotations, respectively. Comprehensive evaluation of 14 state-of-the-art models reveals a substantial gap between semantic understanding and fine-grained pixel-level localization. We further propose UltraG-Agent, which combines the semantic reasoning capabilities of a VLM with the ultrasound-specific segmentation capability of UltraSAM3. Experiments show that UltraG-Agent substantially improves both semantic prediction and pixel-level visual grounding. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/zhuqh19/UltraG-Bench.
2609.30928.paper_summary_zh: 超聲波是最廣泛使用的醫學影像技術之一，最近的大型視覺-語言模型（VLMs）在超聲影像理解方面顯示出日益增強的能力。<lb/>然而，這些模型未能提供與其語義預測對齊的像素級視覺證據，並且它們在超聲中的細粒度基礎能力仍然不清楚。<lb/>我們介紹了UltraG-Bench，一個大型多任務基準，用於評估超聲中的像素級證據基礎。<lb/>UltraG-Bench是通過對涵蓋13個解剖類別的40個公共超聲分割數據集進行標註而建立的，並包含三個漸進的任務：指令引導的分割、基於證據的VQA和基於證據的報告生成，分別有331125、666779和138832個標註。<lb/>對14個最先進模型的綜合評估顯示出語義理解與細粒度像素級定位之間存在顯著差距。<lb/>我們進一步提出UltraG-Agent，該模型結合了VLM的語義推理能力和UltraSAM3的超聲特定分割能力。<lb/>實驗表明UltraG-Agent顯著改善了語義預測和像素級視覺基礎。<lb/>我們的數據集和代碼可在https://github.com/zhuqh19/UltraG-Bench獲得。
